_about: Insurance estimates for /invest/run-the-numbers/ (fix round 1, VERIFIED-BY-FIXER, 2026-11-02). Source pages saved in raw/clovered-landlord-sc.txt and raw/clovered-condo-sc.txt. Clovered is an independent insurance agency; its landlord figures are its homeowner averages plus 15 to 25 percent (its own method, stated on the page). Estimates, not quotes.

condo_unit_sc.quote: The average cost of condo insurance in South Carolina is $501 every year or $42 per month. Average rates depending on coverage amounts, range between $36 and $81 monthly.
condo_unit_sc.quote_mb: HO-6 insurance in Myrtle Beach will likely be on the higher end in South Carolina. ... Notify your insurer if you rent out your condo for part of the year.

used_on_page.condo_note: The top of the state range, $81 x 12 = $972, because the agency puts Myrtle Beach on the higher end and the unit is rented.
